description: Raised beach consisting of cemented sand in a half-saucer-like depression. The cemented mass is divided into four zones: dolomite fragments, rounded pebbles, quartz sand (max 5 inches), and dolomitic pebbles. Found in Durness Dolomites sea-wall.
location_name: Southern shore of Bahnakiel Bay (Bagh Baille-na-Cille), near Durness, Sutherlandshire
bibliographic_reference: Reid, D. M. (1929). 'On a Raised Beach on the North Coast of Scotland'.
notes: Contains burrows of marine annelid and fragments of molluscan shells. Line of demarcation coincides with a fault. Mechanical analysis matches typical shore sand from Beinne Ceannabeinne. No contextual geocode result was found.
